fullPassage: As a political researcher in Germany, Noelle-Neumann observed that during election campaigns, certain views seemed to get more play than others, and sometimes people muted their opinions rather than talking about them, especially if those opinions were perceived to be unpopular. Noelle-Neumann calls this the spiral of silence. The spiral of silence occurs when individuals who perceive that their opinions are popular express them, whereas those who do not think their opinions are popular remain quiet. This process occurs in a spiral, so that one side of an issue ends up with considerable publicity and the other side with very little. In everyday life, people express their opinions in a variety of ways: they talk about them, they wear buttons, they put bumper stickers on their cars, and they post their views on social media. According to this theory, people are more apt to do these kinds of things when they perceive that others share their opinions.

questions.passage: As a political researcher in Germany, Noelle-Neumann observed that during election campaigns, certain views seemed to get more play than others, and sometimes people muted their opinions rather than talking about them, especially if those opinions were perceived to be unpopular. Noelle-Neumann calls this the spiral of silence. The spiral of silence occurs when individuals who perceive that their opinions are popular express them, whereas those who do not think their opinions are popular remain quiet. This process occurs in a spiral, so that one side of an issue ends up with considerable publicity and the other side with very little. In everyday life, people express their opinions in a variety of ways: they talk about them, they wear buttons, they put bumper stickers on their cars, and they post their views on social media. det.korean: ② 나선(spiral)이 함축하는 바 — 의견 표현의 비대칭이 자기 강화적으로 심화됨
det.analysis:
❌ ① 강제 억압(소수의 의견이 다수에 의해 강제로 억압당하는 폭력적 과정) — 본문은 '강제'가 아닌 자발적 침묵. 'people muted their opinions'에서 muted는 스스로 억누른 것

✅ ② 자기 강화(의견 표현의 비대칭이 점점 심화되어 한쪽 목소리만 들리게 되는 자기 강화 현상) — spiral(나선형)은 한 방향으로 점점 강화되는 패턴. 인기 의견→더 표현→더 인기→더 표현의 자기 강화 루프 ←정답

det.tip: spiral = 나선형 = 한 방향으로 점점 강화. 표현↑→인기↑→더 표현↑(자기강화)
